author: Yffe
content:
ARC-2 (#276) — SHIPPING. All three prior STOP-blockers (#277 slice/concat content ens, #278 bytes_eq built-in + bridge, #279 field-access spec byte-view) landed; the editor bytes_eq content pins now discharge L3 AND the editor builds + runs.

PLAN (manifest a-c), pin shapes per 07-strings REQ-18 / AC-14/15:
- insert_str: unchanged-prefix bytes_eq(result.text,b.text,0,0,b.cursor) | inserted-run bytes_eq(result.text,ins,b.cursor,0,ins.len()) | shifted-suffix bytes_eq(result.text,b.text,b.cursor+ins.len(),b.cursor,b.text.len()-b.cursor). LIVE: L3 4/4.
- backspace: prefix bytes_eq(result.text,b.text,0,0,b.cursor-1) | shifted-suffix bytes_eq(result.text,b.text,b.cursor-1,b.cursor,b.text.len()-b.cursor). LIVE: L3 6/6.
- render_frame: payload bytes_eq(result,b.text,7,0,b.text.len()) at the post-clear offset (clear=7 bytes). LIVE: L3 2/2. Residual: trailing format-dependent cursor-coordinate tail NOT byte-pinned (variable-length to_string; bytes_eq pins a fixed window) — honest source comment.

OPERAND SPELLING — bare-field not &-prefixed (DECISIVE): the editor must BOTH check AND build. The &-prefixed form (demo/REQ-18 spelling, check-only) trips an L1 exec-twin bug at build: l1.rs::lower_expr_exec Call string-arg arm emits {lowered}.clone() where lowered already carries the & -> &result.text.clone() = &TString vs owned-TString param -> E0308 at every conjunct. The BARE-FIELD form (one of #279s four sanctioned operand shapes) lowers cleanly through BOTH L3 spec byteview AND L1 exec twin. Design-sanctioned equivalent spelling, NOT weakening (both -> result.text.data@). Spillover exec-twin &-strip gap filed as a follow-up thermite-lower fix (outside manifest).
